title: Mitigating Preference Leakage via Strict Estimator Separation for Normative Generative Ranking
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating 'normative' criteria in generative models, specifically defining 'Moral Theme' as one of its three primary generation constraints. It uses the 'Moral Stories' dataset as a benchmark and evaluates the enactment of pro-social virtues such as honesty, patience, and kindness within specific cultural contexts.
